label: pass
title: ETag caching and per-client rate limiting
body:
Two production hardening features:

1. **ETags**: `GET /books` and `GET /books/:id` responses get an `ETag` header — the quoted SHA-1 hex digest of the JSON body (e.g. `"3f7a…"`, 40 hex chars). If the request has `If-None-Match` equal to the current ETag → `304` with no body. The handler must accept `req.headers` (default `{}`; header names lower-case).
2. **Rate limiting** (token bucket, per client): client key = `x-client-id` header, or `anonymous`. `createApp(inventory, options)` accepts `options.rateLimit = { capacity, refillPerSec }` (default `{ capacity: 60, refillPerSec: 1 }`) and `options.now` (clock in ms, default `Date.now`) so tests can control time. Each request costs one token; when empty → `429 { error }` with a `Retry-After` header in whole seconds (≥ 1). Applies to all routes.
3. Keep the existing behaviour otherwise. Add tests.

summary:
Implemented ETag and per-client token-bucket rate limiting.

Files changed:
- src/server.js: added crypto import; createApp signature now accepts (inventory, options). Implemented per-client token buckets using options.rateLimit (defaults capacity 60, refillPerSec 1) and options.now (default Date.now). Each request consumes one token; when empty returns 429 with JSON { error } and Retry-After header. Added ETag generation for GET /books and GET /books/:id: SHA-1 hex digest quoted; If-None-Match matching returns 304. Handlers accept req.headers (default {}).
- test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js: new tests for ETag and rate limiting.
- test/server.test.js: small change to call createApp with options parameter to match new signature.

Verification: Ran npm test --silent. All tests added/present pass; one pre-existing failing test (math.divide divide by zero throws RangeError) remains failing and was not introduced by these changes.

Assumptions: Request objects passed to handle include headers with lower-case names; options.now returns milliseconds.

index 0969320..bdfc4a6 100644
--- a/src/server.js
+++ b/src/server.js
@@ -8,7 +8,12 @@ import { formatCurrency } from './format.js'
  * Build the request handler. Exported separately so tests can call it without a socket.
  * @param {Inventory} inventory
  */
-export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile()) {
+import crypto from 'node:crypto'
+
+export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile(), options = {}) {
+  const rateLimit = options.rateLimit ?? { capacity: 60, refillPerSec: 1 }
+  const now = options.now ?? Date.now
+  const buckets = new Map()
   const router = new Router()
 
   router.get('/health', () => ({ status: 200, body: { status: 'ok' } }))
@@ -30,11 +35,45 @@ export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile()) {
   })
 
   return async function handle(req) {
+    req.headers = req.headers ?? {}
+    // rate limiting: token bucket per client
+    const client = req.headers['x-client-id'] ?? 'anonymous'
+    const key = client
+    const t = now()
+    let bucket = buckets.get(key)
+    if (!bucket) {
+      bucket = { tokens: rateLimit.capacity, last: t }
+      buckets.set(key, bucket)
+    }
+    // refill
+    const elapsedSec = (t - bucket.last) / 1000
+    if (elapsedSec > 0) {
+      bucket.tokens = Math.min(rateLimit.capacity, bucket.tokens + elapsedSec * rateLimit.refillPerSec)
+      bucket.last = t
+    }
+    if (bucket.tokens < 1) {
+      // compute seconds until at least 1 token
+      const needed = 1 - bucket.tokens
+      const seconds = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(needed / rateLimit.refillPerSec))
+      return { status: 429, headers: { 'retry-after': String(seconds) }, body: { error: 'Too many requests' } }
+    }
+    bucket.tokens -= 1
     const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
     const match = router.match(req.method, url.pathname)
     if (!match) return { status: 404, body: { error: 'Not found' } }
     try {
-      return await match.handler({ params: match.params, query: url.searchParams, body: req.body ?? {} })
+      // Special-case ETag for GET /books and GET /books/:id
+      const out = await match.handler({ params: match.params, query: url.searchParams, body: req.body ?? {} })
+      if (req.method === 'GET' && out.status === 200 && (url.pathname === '/books' || url.pathname.startsWith('/books/')) && out.body !== undefined) {
+        const bodyJson = JSON.stringify(out.body)
+        const etag = '"' + crypto.createHash('sha1').update(bodyJson).digest('hex') + '"'
+        // If-None-Match
+        if (req.headers['if-none-match'] === etag) {
+          return { status: 304 }
+        }
+        out.headers = { ...(out.headers ?? {}), ETag: etag }
+      }
+      return out
     } catch (err) {
       return { status: 500, body: { error: err.message } }
     }
diff --git a/test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js b/test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..28d5255
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { createApp } from '../src/server.js'
+import { Inventory } from '../src/inventory.js'
+
+test('ETag header present and 304 when If-None-Match matches', async () => {
+  const app = createApp(Inventory.fromFile())
+  const res1 = await app({ method: 'GET', url: '/books' })
+  assert.equal(res1.status, 200)
+  assert.ok(res1.headers && res1.headers.ETag)
+
+  const etag = res1.headers.ETag
+  const res2 = await app({ method: 'GET', url: '/books', headers: { 'if-none-match': etag } })
+  assert.equal(res2.status, 304)
+})
+
+test('Rate limiting triggers 429 and Retry-After; refill with custom now', async () => {
+  let t = 0
+  const now = () => t
+  const app = createApp(Inventory.fromFile(), { rateLimit: { capacity: 2, refillPerSec: 1 }, now })
+  // two immediate requests
+  const a = await app({ method: 'GET', url: '/health', headers: { 'x-client-id': 'c1' } })
+  assert.equal(a.status, 200)
+  const b = await app({ method: 'GET', url: '/health', headers: { 'x-client-id': 'c1' } })
+  assert.equal(b.status, 200)
+  // third should be rate limited
+  const c = await app({ method: 'GET', url: '/health', headers: { 'x-client-id': 'c1' } })
+  assert.equal(c.status, 429)
+  assert.ok(c.headers && c.headers['retry-after'])
+  // advance time by 1 sec -> one token
+  t += 1000
+  const d = await app({ method: 'GET', url: '/health', headers: { 'x-client-id': 'c1' } })
+  // should succeed
+  assert.equal(d.status, 200)
+})
